name: Kirari
source:
A popular gal who's friendly with everyone and treats all people equally, including the very unpopular protagonist. She hates bullying and acts as a mediator. Despite her slutty style of dress, she's a virgin who's interested in sex and a shameless flirt, awaiting a person to make love to.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://www.miel-soft.com/harafure.html]official website[/url]]
